branch_additions.title: Competitive common-continuation certificates for stochastic families
branch_additions.hypothesis: A small common continuation invariant can replace repeated family/horizon evaluation when discovery amortizes.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: Many variants affect internal state but share long-horizon safety responses.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Exact raw-row compiler, external whole-family Storm baseline, short-horizon and high-rank losses, altered-row falsifiers.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: External end-to-end comparison including proof cost, independent answers, negative cases. SOTA promotion also requires public cases and structural competitors.
branch_additions.contribution: Executed35 query cases versus Storm via Stormpy2.0.0. Long-horizon synthetic advantage16.54–26.22x including compile. Short horizons/actual CDKA lose. Exact4096-variant CDKA certificate at rank7.

rejected_additions.claim: Beating per-variant enumeration establishes superiority over current family solvers.
rejected_additions.reason: Strong comparators analyze one lifted family; that is the executed baseline.

rejected_additions.claim: A fast low-rank hot query implies a faster whole computation on every input.
rejected_additions.reason: Exact compile makes the pilot slower for short horizons and the original48-state CDKA fixture. All costs and losses are reported.

assessment_policy: Correctness, concrete contribution, priority, coverage and competitive performance are separate. Preserve adaptations as contributions and do not elevate a synthetic pilot to general SOTA. Earlier ledgers unchanged.
